base_branch.description: the pair's base branch, the public branch it works against: public_branch from the overlay config, main when the key is missing; a feature whose parent is main is on it

commits.description: the feature's own commits, since its fork point when it records one (a stacked feature) and else since the public base branch, oldest first; empty when the branch is gone. Each one's files are what it changes from its parent, overlay paths left out.

ledger.description: this pair's ledger entries for the feature, oldest first
